title: 第11章 入住第12章 一年
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
清晨，如镜般的湖面上蒸腾着乳白色水雾，仿佛披上一层轻纱，几朵白莲在水中摇曳着，不时有新凝的露水从上面滑下。
打顾安来到白镜湖畔已有三日，在黑岩城主不计人力的投入下，一座青石小院已在湖心岛筑起，今日就能入住。
从湖边草庐走出，顾安得知小院建好后，便清退了一众凡人，只留下两个侍女，并告诫黑岩城主无事不得打扰。
看着黑岩城主带着一群人离开，顾安颇为满意他的识趣，不由得微微点头。
待得众人走远，顾安悠悠地收回目光，“一人之需，万人奔走，这就是修仙者吗？真是令人沉醉啊！”
“然而鸟巢深林，不过一枝，偃鼠饮河，不过满腹。”
“致虚极，守静笃，万物并作，吾以成仙。”
“还是灵力一点一滴的增加，更令人着迷。”
自我勉励一番，顾安脚尖轻点，在湖面上奔走起来，仔细看便能发现，每次脚尖落在湖面，都有一处淡蓝色的灵力凝结，以此为借力。
顾安双手轻拍，一片黑云从湖底游出，原来是黑灵鱼，其身上生有黑褐色花纹，背鳍细长，头呈梭形，仰头露出水面，张口讨要吃食。
“诶，又死了一只。”顾安数着灵鱼，心生烦恼，这些天【灵源回馈】一直响个不停，便选择屏蔽了提示声。
“哗啦。”
一朵水花溅到顾安脸上，几只灵鱼见顾安迟迟不拿出好吃的，焦急地用尾巴拍打着水面，溅了一脸水花。
顾安看着几十双死鱼眼瞪着他，颇有些跃跃欲试的样子，赶紧从储物袋中拿出准备好的谷米，一把把的撒下去，口中嘀咕，“瞪什么瞪，等一年后就把你们卖了，然后不知道被谁吃掉，就知道道爷我的好了。”
“看谁表现好，我就留下谁做种鱼，允许它生下鱼苗，然后再被道爷我吃掉。”
“既能留下血脉，又省却颠沛流离之苦，岂不美哉。”
“道爷的恩情你就还吧！”
……
在灵鱼边画了会大饼，没有得到积极的情绪反馈，黑灵鱼还是一副死鱼眼瞪着，顾安顿感无趣，转身来到湖心小院。
此时晨雾未散，小院像枚湿漉漉的玉玦在湖心躺着，新砌的院墙泛着青灰色，并不多高，能从墙内看见外面的湖景。

轩窗半卷，红木掩门，青瓦垒起的滴水檐一道道的，晨雾凝成水滴滑下。小院座西朝东，一棵移植来的垂柳立于小院南边，柳枝垂在窗前，北边是两小屋，顾安打算一间储米，一间住那两侍女。
正西是正屋，由外而内是外室，此间最大，用来接待客人，顾安倒不大用得上，接着是卧房，一塌一桌而已，最里间是修炼室，摆着一蒲团一案几。
整座小院透露着一股穷酸，黑岩城主倒是想送些花里胡哨的物件，被顾安拒绝了，一些凡物，没必要刻意追求。
“白芷，青榴，你二人以后就住在外头第一间屋里，以后每日打扫下院子，整理下外屋即可。”
“里间不要进，另外记住，不许私自去喂鱼！”
顾安看着两名侍女，两侍女一青一白，倒是好认。左侧少女瓜子脸，杏眼含露，簪着青色玉簪，浅青布裙裹住伶仃腰身。右侧是个鹅蛋脸，素白襦裙干净利落，乌发齐整。
“奴记住了，绝不会犯。”两人忙跪下回话。
顾安微微颔首，示意二人起来，“以后不必跪下说话，你二人都是个什么出身？”
虽然不相信那黑岩城主有胆子做什么手脚，可防人之心不可无，他初次离宗驻守，万事小心为妙。
“奴是黑岩城张家的，父亲是这黑岩城的城主。”白芷软糯糯的开口，抢先一步回答。
“奴是黑岩城甄家，家里做些粮食生意。”青榴也赶忙说道。
“嗯，我不管你们是什么背景，来到这就好好做事。”顾安也看不出来有什么不对，但还是出声敲打。
content_en:
In the early morning, the mirror-like lake surface is covered with milky white mist, as if covered with a layer of gauze. Several white lotus flowers are swaying in the water, and from time to time, newly condensed dew slides down from it.
It has been three days since Gu An arrived at the Baijing Lake. With the investment of Black Rock City Lord regardless of manpower, a small bluestone courtyard has been built on the island in the middle of the lake. You can move in today.
Walking out of the thatched cottage by the lake, Gu An learned that after the small courtyard was built, he cleared away all the mortals, leaving only two maids, and warned the Lord of Black Rock City not to disturb them if nothing happened.
Seeing the Lord of Black Rock City leaving with a group of people, Gu An was quite satisfied with his knowledge and couldn't help but nodded slightly.
After everyone walked away, Gu An looked away leisurely, "One person needs it, and thousands of people run around. Is this a cultivator? It's really intoxicating!"
"However, a bird's nest deep in the forest is only a branch, and a rat drinking from the river is only a full belly."
"To reach the extreme of emptiness, stay still and sincere, and work together with all things, I will become an immortal."
"It's even more fascinating that the spiritual power is increasing bit by bit."
After encouraging himself, Gu An tapped his toes and started running on the lake. If he looked carefully, he could find that every time his toes landed on the lake, there was a light blue spiritual power condensation, which he used as a source of strength.
Gu An patted his hands lightly, and a black cloud swam out from the bottom of the lake. It turned out to be a black spirit fish. It had dark brown patterns on its body, a slender dorsal fin, and a spindle-shaped head. It raised its head above the water and opened its mouth to beg for food.
"Hey, another one died." Gu An was counting the spirit fish, feeling troubled. The [Spirit Source Feedback] had been ringing non-stop these days, so he chose to block the notification sound.
"Wow."
A splash of water splashed on Gu An's face. Seeing that Gu An was still reluctant to take out the delicious food, several spirit fish anxiously slapped the water with their tails, splashing water all over their faces.
Gu An looked at dozens of pairs of dead fish eyes staring at him, looking quite eager to try. He quickly took out the prepared rice from the storage bag and sprinkled it in handfuls, muttering in his mouth, "Why are you staring? I will sell you in a year, and then I don't know who will eat it. I will know that it is mine."
"Whoever performs well, I will keep him as a seed fish and allow him to give birth to fry, and then I will eat him."
"Wouldn't it be nice to be able to leave a legacy and save the pain of displacement?"
"You should repay Master Dao's kindness!"
…
After drawing pie next to the spiritual fish for a while, he didn't get any positive emotional feedback. The black spiritual fish still stared with dead eyes. Gu An felt bored and turned around to the small courtyard in the middle of the lake.
At this time, the morning fog has not dispersed, and the small courtyard lies like a wet jade in the middle of the lake. The newly built courtyard wall is greenish-grey and not very high. The lake view outside can be seen from inside the wall.
The windows are half-rolled, the doors are covered with mahogany, and the dripping eaves built up with blue tiles are lined with dripping eaves. The morning mist condenses into water droplets and slides down. The small courtyard faces west and faces east. A transplanted weeping willow stands on the south side of the small courtyard, with its branches hanging in front of the window. On the north side are two small rooms. Gu An planned to store rice in one room and live in the other room for the two maids.
To the west is the main room, and from the outside to the inside is the outer room. This is the largest room and is used to receive guests. Gu An has little use for it. Then there is the bedroom, which is just a table. The innermost room is the training room, with a futon and a table.
The entire courtyard exuded a sense of poverty. The Lord of Black Rock City wanted to give some fancy items, but Gu An refused. There was no need to pursue some ordinary items.
"Baizhi, Qingliu, you two will live in the first room outside from now on. From now on, you can clean the yard and tidy up the outhouse every day."
"Don't go inside, and remember, you're not allowed to feed the fish without permission!"
Gu An looked at the two maids. One was green and the other was white. They were easy to recognize. The girl on the left has an oval face, almond-shaped eyes, a green hairpin, and a light green cloth skirt wrapped around her waist. The one on the right has an oval face, a clean white undershirt, and neat black hair.
"I remember this, I will never do it." The two men knelt down and replied.
Gu An nodded slightly and motioned for the two of them to get up, "You don't have to kneel down to talk in the future. What are your backgrounds?"
AlthoughI don’t believe that the Lord of Black Rock City has the guts to do anything, but he must be on guard against others. It is his first time to leave the sect to guard, so it is best to be careful in everything.
"This slave belongs to the Zhang family in Black Rock City, and my father is the city lord of Black Rock City." Bai Zhi spoke softly and answered first.
"This slave is from the Zhen family in Black Rock City. My family does some food business." Qingliu also said quickly.
"Well, I don't care what your background is, just do your job well when you come here." Gu An couldn't see anything wrong, but he still made a sound.
